title: Detection of placental RNA allelic ratio in maternal plasma by matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry
protocol: Collect at least 3.5 mL of blood into EDTA tubes.
Store the blood samples at 4 °C for a maximum of 6 hours if processing cannot take place immediately.
Centrifuge the whole blood at 1,600g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer plasma into clean polypropylene tubes carefully to avoid disturbing the cellular layer.
Recentrifuge the plasma at 16,000g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Carefully transfer the supernatant into clean polypropylene tubes without disturbing the cell pellet.
Discard the cell pellet.
Add 1.2 mL of Trizol LS reagent per 0.4 mL of plasma in a clean 2 mL polypropylene tube.
Vortex vigorously to mix the plasma and Trizol LS thoroughly.
Store the plasma-Trizol LS mixture at -80 °C until RNA extraction is performed.
Clean the laboratory bench and equipment with RNase Away before each extraction.
Use sterile RNase-free plasticware for all procedures.
Thaw 6.4 mL of the plasma-Trizol LS mixture prepared in step 4.
For every 1.6 mL of the plasma-Trizol LS mixture, add 320 μL of chloroform.
Shake the tubes vigorously by hand.
Centrifuge the mixture at 12,000g for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer the upper aqueous layer into new tubes.
The volume of the aqueous layer is approximately 850 μL for each 1.6 mL of plasma-Trizol LS mixture.
Add 457 μL of absolute ethanol per 850 μL of the aqueous layer and mix by inverting the tubes.
Apply 700 μL of the mixture into an RNeasy minicolumn.
Centrifuge at 9300g for 15 s.
Discard the flow-through.
Apply another 700 μL of the mixture into the same extraction column.
Repeat step applying 700 μL to the column seven more times until all mixture is loaded.
Add 700 μL of Buffer RW1 to the column.
Centrifuge at 9300g for 1 min.
Discard the flow-through.
Add 500 μL of Buffer RPE to the column.
Centrifuge at 9300g for 15 s.
Discard the flow-through.
Add another 500 μL of Buffer RPE to the column.
Centrifuge at 16,000g for 2 min.
Discard the flow-through.
Centrifuge the column at 16,000g for 1 min.
Place the column in a new 1.5 mL tube.
Add 48 μL of RNase-free water into the column.
Incubate the column for 5 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge the column at 16,000g for 1 min.
Apply the eluate into the same column.
Incubate the column for another 5 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge the column at 16,000g for 1 min.
Store the extracted RNA at -80°C if DNase I digestion cannot be carried out immediately.
Add 4.8 μL each of 10x DNase I Reaction Buffer and DNase I to 48 μL of plasma RNA on ice.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate the reaction for 15 min at room temperature.
Add 4.8 μL of EDTA to the reaction mix.
Incubate the reaction for 10 min at 65°C.
Place the tubes on ice after incubation.
Store the RNA at -80°C.
Serially dilute the synthetic DNA oligonucleotide into concentrations: 2.5 x 10^6, 2.5 x 10^5, 2.5 x 10^4, 2.5 x 10^3, 2.5 x 10^2, 25 and 2.5 copies/μL.

Prepare QRT-PCR reaction master mix with the following components for one reaction: 5 μL of 5x TaqMan EZ Buffer, 3 μL of manganese acetate, 0.75 μL each of dATP, dCTP, dGTP, and dUTP, 1 μL each of forward QRT-PCR primer and reverse QRT-PCR primer, 0.5 μL of TaqMan MGB probe, 1 μL of r_Tth_ DNA Polymerase, 0.25 μL of AmpErase uracil N-glycosylase (UNG), and 5.25 μL of water.
Aliquot 20 μL of the master mix into each well.
Perform duplicated reactions for each sample, no template control (NTC) and calibration curve.
Add 5 μL of RNA sample to the sample wells.
Add 5 μL of RNase free water to the NTC wells.
Cover the wells with optical caps.
Cap both the samples and NTC wells immediately before adding the calibration curve.
Add 5 μL of each concentration of synthetic oligonucleotide into the calibration wells.
Cover the wells with optical caps.
Perform QRT-PCR at 50°C for 2 minutes.
Incubate at 60°C for 30 minutes.
Denature at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Cycle through 45 cycles of denaturation at 95°C for 15 seconds and annealing/extension at 60°C for 1 minute.
Calculate RNA concentration using the equation C = Q x (V_RNA / V_Plasma).
Interpret results carefully if the RNA concentration is very low.
Add 4.8 μL of gene-specific primer and 9.6 μL of dNTP mixture to 48 μL of the DNase-treated plasma RNA.
Incubate the mixture at 65°C for 5 minutes.
Place the mixture on ice.
Add 19.2 μL of 5x cDNA Synthesis Buffer, 4.8 μL each of DTT, RNaseOUT, and ThermoScript enzyme into the reaction.
Immediately place the mixture in a pre-heated thermocycler at 55°C.
Incubate the reaction at 55°C for 60 minutes.
Incubate the reaction at 85°C for 5 minutes.
Store the cDNA at -20°C if PCR amplification cannot be carried out immediately.

Prepare PCR reaction with the following components: 12 μL of 10x PCR Buffer, 2 μL of dNTP mixture, 4 μL of forward PCR primer, 4 μL of reverse PCR primer, 0.8 μL of HotStar Taq polymerase, and 77.2 μL of water.
Add 100 μL of synthesized cDNA to the PCR reaction components.
Prepare a NTC tube according to the components in step 29, replacing cDNA with 100 μL water.
Perform PCR as follows: incubate at 95°C for 7 min, followed by 55 cycles of 40 s at 95°C, 1 min at 56°C, and 1 min at 72°C, then incubate at 72°C for 3 min.
Store the PCR product at -20°C if base extension reaction cannot be carried out immediately.
Dephosphorylate any remaining dNTPs in the PCR product with shrimp alkaline phosphatase (SAP).
Add 0.34 μL of hME buffer and 0.6 μL of SAP to 25 μL of the PCR product, mix thoroughly.
Incubate at 37°C for 40 min, followed by 85°C for 5 min.

Prepare base extension reaction with the following components: add 0.4 μL of ddATP/ddCTP/ddTTP/dGTP mixture, 1.68 μL of extension primer, 0.036 μL of Thermosequenase, and 6.884 μL of water to 5 μL of SAP-treated PCR product.
Perform the reaction as follows:
Incubate the base extension product at 94°C for 2 minutes.
Perform 100 cycles of PCR with denaturation at 94°C for 5 seconds, annealing at 52°C for 5 seconds, and elongation at 72°C for 5 seconds.
Store the base extension product at -20°C if MALDI-TOF MS analysis cannot be carried out immediately.
Add 24 μL of water and 12 mg of SpectroCLEAN resin to the reaction product.
Place the mixture on a rotator for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge the mixture at 361g for 5 minutes.
Dispense the final reaction solution onto a SpectroCHIP using a SpectroPoint nanodispenser.
Acquire mass spectrometric data by a MassARRAY Analyzer Compact Mass Spectrometer.
